mapper.select: SELECT r.group_id AS groupId, g.name AS groupName, r.value_id AS valueId, v.`value` AS valueName FROM product_sku_attribute_rel r JOIN product_attribute_group g ON g.id = r.group_id AND g.delete_flag = '0' JOIN product_attribute_value v ON v.id = r.value_id AND v.delete_flag = '0' WHERE r.sku_id = #{skuId} AND r.delete_flag = '0' ORDER BY r.group_id
